description: Simulates exactly one Minecraft anvil operation — combining `item` (the base, left slot) with `sacrifice` (the right slot), optionally renaming the result — with no search or planning: it's a direct simulation of that specific in-game anvil use, not a 'find the cheapest way to reach X' query. Returns the XP-level cost, feasibility, and the resulting enchantments. A sacrifice enchantment the base item cannot take (e.g. Efficiency from a book onto a sword) is ignored by the anvil: cost 0, `transferred: false`. For finding the cheapest multi-step path from a current state to a target enchantment set, use anvil_migration_path instead.

level.description: Enchantment level (Roman-numeral level as an integer)

id.description: Item id, e.g. 'diamond_sword', or 'book'/'enchanted_book' for a book

material.description: Optional material override for the item, if applicable

name.description: This item's existing custom name, if any

priorWorkCount.description: This item's own 'too expensive' prior-work counter, if it has already been anvil-combined before (0 if fresh)

newName.description: Desired custom name for the result. A rename is included only if this differs from item.name (use '' to clear an existing name) — cost is a flat +1 XP level, the actual text has no effect on cost. Omit to leave the name untouched.
